notionUpdate.content:
M08 update f5574cb3-abee-45c8-9002-77cb1b6f93af — November 15, 2026 UTC. Keep the existing task In progress with all three acceptance criteria and the M07 dependency open. The owner changed the workflow to follower-only three-point capture/replay, then explicitly stopped experiments after reporting that the robot collided with the table. No further physical action, readiness request, retry or guard relaxation is pending or authorized.

Preserve the first teach refusal before writes and the second attempt's three saved manual poses. The original 15-second-segment planner rejected its speed bound after saving the poses. A separately authorized three-round replay used 24-second segments and the unchanged original poses/limits. It issued real goals but aborted at 08:07:42.608878Z on gripper voltage 11.4 V below the retained 11.5 V guard. The saved command prefix reaches only 6.9 seconds of the first route segment: zero segments and zero rounds complete. Cleanup reports all six motors torque off with no errors and a closed port. The operator-reported table collision is separate evidence; its timing and causal relation to voltage are unknown. Putting the arm back is not proof of motor-power isolation or a damage inspection.

Current code unconditionally refuses replay before data, journal, timer, serial or follower access and at the direct replay entry, with no CLI bypass. Final CLI SHA 0da4ee3f411c74d6c5ecc5a18df15a6dba41e2ec5dd5f3906adede0e86a35baa. Final 65 offline tests passed at 08:12:32Z: five real unpatched hold checks, 42 historical fake-bus tests with an isolated gate mock, and 18 planner tests. These are software evidence, not physical clearance or successful replay. Preserve the exact executed incident source 1fd43e2395c0f8ce74877d01110545d6add2d82ea4c09d2d42478593c6e122b6 and all hardware records.

Attribution: /root implemented/integrated the adapter, owned operator authorization and actual hardware attempts, recorded the incident/stop and implemented the hold; /root/dashboard authored the pure core/18 tests, inspected the existing environment/help and finalized the incident-aware README; /root/reconcile authored I/O/hold tests and independently audited calibration, source and saved replay; /root/shared_sync verified shared instructions, exact note/source receipts and the prior Notion readback, and prepared the coherent source delivery. Source delivery c8898652-f488-4bd3-8f9f-8793047edf52, transfer ecbcfc1c-3e6e-40fe-8b98-0d3eff7a16c8, completion note cabcb290-299a-4850-931a-f731fecadbda. Reconstruction/review/publication and this Notion update need separate confirmation; paused recurring Mac review must not be restarted. Preserve the two already confirmed older update IDs and all dated corrections.
